library(dplyr)
library(sf)

open = sites %>% filter(site != "none")   # facilities still open
bg_sf = st_as_sf(bg, coords = c("x", "y"), crs = 32618)
open_sf = st_as_sf(open, coords = c("x", "y"), crs = 32618)

# Straight line (Voronoi): the nearest facility as the crow flies
near = st_nearest_feature(bg_sf, open_sf)
bg$voronoi = open$site[near]
bg$voronoi_m = as.numeric(st_distance(bg_sf, open_sf[near, ], by_element = TRUE))

# Travel time: the smallest minutes in each row of the travel-time matrix
m = as.matrix(tt[, open$site])
bg$travel = open$site[apply(m, 1, which.min)]
bg$travel_min = apply(m, 1, min)

bg = bg %>%
  mutate(site = voronoi, cost = voronoi_m) %>%
  group_by(site) %>%
  arrange(cost, id, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(served = TRUE) %>%   # nearest demand first
  ungroup()

loads = bg %>% filter(served) %>% count(site, wt = pop, name = "load") %>% arrange(desc(load))
list(
  top_site = loads$site[1],
  top_load = loads$load[1],
  bg_changed = sum(bg$voronoi != bg$travel),
  pop_changed = sum(bg$pop[bg$voronoi != bg$travel]),
  unserved = sum(bg$pop[!bg$served]),
  open_sites = nrow(open))
